title: Sri Ramanujacharya
summary: A major acharya associated with Vishishtadvaita Vedanta and the Sri Vaishnava tradition.
content: Sri Ramanujacharya is a central acharya in the Sri Vaishnava tradition. He is closely associated with the systematic exposition of Vishishtadvaita Vedanta. His life, works, teachings, and traditional accounts should be studied through reliable biographies and Sri Vaishnava sources.
review_note: Check historical details, traditional accounts, and interpretations with reliable sources and a knowledgeable Sri Vaishnava teacher.

title: Vishishtadvaita Vedanta
summary: A Vedanta philosophical tradition particularly associated with Sri Ramanujacharya.
content: Vishishtadvaita is commonly translated as qualified non-dualism. It is associated with Sri Ramanujacharya and forms an important philosophical foundation of Sri Vaishnavism. Its precise explanations of Brahman, the individual self, and the world should be studied through dedicated philosophical texts and traditional commentaries.

title: Sri Vaishnavism
summary: A Vaishnava tradition centered on devotion to Sriman Narayana and a rich lineage of Azhwars and Acharyas.
content: Sri Vaishnavism is a Vaishnava tradition with a rich body of Sanskrit and Tamil devotional literature, philosophical works, temple practices, and teacher-disciple lineages. Sriman Narayana, Sri or Lakshmi, the Azhwars, and the Acharyas have important places in its teachings. Detailed theological explanations should be presented with appropriate traditional sources.

title: The Azhwars
summary: Twelve revered Tamil poet-saints associated with devotional hymns to Vishnu.
content: The Azhwars are twelve revered poet-saints of the Tamil Vaishnava tradition. Their devotional hymns are an important part of the tradition's literary and spiritual heritage. The traditional accounts of each Azhwar, their works, and their chronology should be documented individually with suitable sources.

title: Naalayira Divya Prabandham
summary: A collection of Tamil devotional hymns associated with the Azhwars.
content: The Naalayira Divya Prabandham is a foundational collection of Tamil devotional hymns revered in Sri Vaishnavism. Its name is traditionally associated with four thousand hymns or verses. The collection's individual works, authorship, arrangement, and recitation traditions deserve separate, carefully sourced entries.

title: Andal
summary: A revered woman poet-saint counted among the twelve Azhwars.
content: Andal is revered in Sri Vaishnavism as one of the twelve Azhwars. Tiruppavai and Nachiyar Tirumozhi are associated with her. Her hymns, devotional significance, and traditional life account should be studied alongside reliable editions and traditional commentaries.

title: Divya Desams
summary: Sacred Vishnu temples praised in the hymns of the Azhwars.
content: Divya Desams are sacred places associated with Vishnu and praised in the Azhwars' devotional hymns. The traditional count is 108. A useful expansion of this entry would list each Divya Desam with its traditional name, present-day location, associated hymns, and reliable references.
